If you are not using the newest version, download and try that before opening an issue.

Provide the model of your device. A link to the Wavespa product page is sometimes useful.

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

<!--
Please attach a diagnostics download if you can: on the WaveSpa integration

what is needed to diagnose a problem. Credentials and identifiers are redacted
automatically.
-->
